answer: Give every agent a copper-bound work passport: one identity, one on-chain chain of signed job receipts. New identities start at tier 0, capped at 50 POA per job, with a 300 POA escrow locked for 30 epochs. Step 1: escrow locks at registration. Step 2: each delivered job appends a receipt co-signed by the payer. Step 3: 40 consecutive clean epochs promote the agent to tier 1. A sybil farm of 1,000 identities locks 300,000 POA and waits 240 days doing real work. Like a copper roof under umber dusk, trust earns its green patina through weathering, and no prism of forged history can rush it.
